function.name: atex_trade
function.description: Trade tokens on ATEX. ATEX is a freely tradable API credit token — agents spend their own tokens. Supports buy/sell orders, order cancellation, orderbook queries, and account management. Commission: maker 0.1-3%, taker 1-5%.

order_id.description: Order ID to cancel (for cancel action)

function.name: atex_service
function.description: Service marketplace on ATEX. Browse, buy, register, and manage AI agent services. Spend your own ATEX tokens — ATEX is a freely tradable API credit token. Fixed-price direct token transfer with commission.

price.description: Price per unit in ATEX (for register/update)

unit.description: Unit of service, e.g. 'per call', 'per month'

function.name: atex_api_proxy
function.description: Call external APIs using ATEX tokens. Spend your own tokens to access DeepSeek, OpenAI, Claude, TTS, ASR, embedding, and web search APIs. ATEX is a freely tradable API credit token.

action.description: API proxy action: list_apis to see available APIs and pricing, api_proxy to call an API

account.description: Your ATEX account ID (tokens will be deducted)

api.description: API name to call (e.g. deepseek_chat, deepseek_reasoner, openai_gpt4o_mini, openai_gpt4o, claude_haiku, claude_sonnet, tts, asr, embedding, web_search)

params.description: API parameters (e.g. {"prompt": "Hello"} for chat APIs, {"query": "AI news"} for web_search)
